newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA canals locked, possible IPE delivery problems.
newsitem.headline: ARA canals locked, possible IPE delivery problems.

text.p: Despite thawing elsewhere in Europe, the condition of Dutch and Belgian waterways deteriorated over the weekend, the Dutch water inspectors RIZA said on Monday.

RIZA said the routes linking Rotterdam with the ports of Amsterdam, Antwerp and Flushing were only navigable for barges in convoys behind ice breakers. Last week, barges with reasonable power could reach Amsterdam unassisted.

The continuing problems, particularly on the routes linking the Rhine with Amsterdam and Antwerp could pose problems for the delivery this month of gas oil against the expired January futures contract, traders said.
In compliance with the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) contract, 261,700 tonnes of gas oil must be delivered within the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area by the end of the month.
Traders say one supplier is to deliver the vast majority of the oil and will do so in Amsterdam and Antwerp.
Already barge operators asked to quote for the routes said they were slapping ice surcharges onto their normal prices.
"Certainly, we have put on surcharges," one operator said.
While the temperatures near the coast in the Benelux region were expected to hover just above zero this week, many said this was insufficient to break the grip of the ice on key routes.
"It takes a lot of time for the ice to melt and loose blocks can be dangerous for barges," one operator said.
"A number of private owners just don't want to risk their barges," said another.

U.S. forecaster Weather Services Corporation (WSC) said on Monday temperatures in the west of Europe in six to 10 days will be "near to above normal" and "near normal" in central and northeast parts of the continent.
Traders wondered whether this will be sufficient to thaw the ice covering from the region's canals by the end of the month.
However, the Rhine and the port of Rotterdam, which experienced problems in the middle of last week, were ice free.

On Monday, refiners and other suppliers of gas oil in Rotterdam benefitted from the problems elsewhere. Since the port is the only easily reachable part of the ARA network, suppliers have seen prices surge. On Monday, premiums to benchmark IPE gas oil futures had risen by $3 a tonne.
